title: The Woebegone Wonder Girl Wants to Be Wicked
titleRomaji: Munou Saijo wa Akujo ni Naritai: Gimai no Migawari de Totsuida Reijou, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai
titleEnglish: The Woebegone Wonder Girl Wants to Be Wicked
titleNative: 無能才女は悪女になりたい ～義妹の身代わりで嫁いだ令嬢、公爵様の溺愛に気づかない～
synonyms: An Incompetent Woman Wants to Be a Villainess ~The Daughter Who Married as a Substitute for Her Stepsister Didn't Notice the Duke's Doting~
synopsis: Despite her hidden genius, Avril has lived a life of misery, constantly belittled as useless by her own family. When she is forced to substitute for her wicked step-sister in a marriage to a supposedly lecherous, old duke, Avril expects the worst. But surprisingly, Duke Dylan is actually a breathtakingly handsome young man. He offers her a deal: act as his villainess wife for three years, and then they will divorce. For Avril, this contract is a golden ticket to her ultimate freedom. But as she enthusiastically embraces her new evil persona, her mysterious charm leaves the duke and his household completely bewildered and entirely enchanted. (Source: Kadokawa)

When a sly professor discovers his racket, Jonathan agrees to a physical relationship in exchange for keeping mum. title: Rakuen wo Mezashite
synopsis: A comedian, gone, leaved behind his wife, Kyoko, and his daughter not yet a year old. Determined to hold what remains of his brother's family together, the older brother Shouji moves in with them, under one roof. But Shouji carries something invisible with him: a mind pulled between two extremes. The restless, frenzied heights of mania, and the slow, suffocating weight of depression. Eat. Work. Sleep. Wake. Even the most ordinary rhythms of daily life become a mountain to climb. And yet, the three of them reach toward something worth living for. A stepfamily story from an author with bipolar disorder. (Source: Comic Days, translated)
